item.title: RyukGram Side by Side v448.0.0
item.description:
Instagram 448.0.0 | RyukGram Side by Side
### 🆕 New features - Pick from the RyukGram gallery inside Instagram: Send from gallery in the DM + menu, hold the photo button in comments, or hold Recents in the story, post and reel galleries - Repost from the gallery: hold any photo, video or GIF and post it as a story, post or reel - Activity notifications can track only the people in your list - Hold the story background button to pick any solid color or gradient, with a direction dial - Safari extension: Open in RyukGram banner at the top or bottom, removes Instagram's app prompts, blocks App Store jumps, and can open links automatically - Crash logs under Debug > Logging: saves a report when Instagram crashes, with search, share, and a hint when RyukGram is in the trace - Share log file can bundle your crash reports into the same file - Notification history: every notification in one place, filter by feature or type, search, choose which features get saved, and a home shortcut with new counts - Sound toggle in the reels and stories playback panels - Picture in Picture button in the reels playback panel - Reels auto-scroll moves past sponsored and photo reels - Post spoofing: pick your own posts and fake their likes, comments, views, shares, reposts and saves, only on your device - Strip tracking menu: one place for shared and opened links, edit which params get removed, or drop every param a shared link does not need - Embed domain and tracking param lists support multi-select delete - Instagram API page in Advanced: reuse recent replies for a set time, pace requests, and cap daily follows and unfollows - Hide Meta AI now also removes AI images from the gallery picker - Hide search suggestions: removes suggested accounts and searches from the search tab - Custom notification sounds: set your own sound for DMs and for other alerts, import from Files, Photos or the gallery and trim it, or use Instagram's own tones - Opening someone's profile picture now shows every picture on the account, not just the first - Each active MobileConfig override shows how many times Instagram read it - Find unnamed MobileConfig entries by the code that reads them, and label them with it - MobileConfig overrides can be switched off and back on without losing their values, one config or all at once - MobileConfig params can be filtered to overridden only, or by platform - Hold any MobileConfig config to give it your own note, shown on the row, inside it, and searchable - Search MobileConfig by note, param name or id as well as by name and number - Gallery editing: crop, rotate and resize photos, trim and crop videos, trim audio, pull or strip a video's audio, turn GIFs into videos, then save as new or replace the original - Gallery info page: edit a file's name and source details, see camera and codec info, and remove a photo's location - Redesigned photo crop editor for Draw and chat backgrounds: more ratios, draggable free crop, flip, and zoom out to fit - Spoofing is now one editor shaped like your profile header, Threads badge included: tap anything to change it, then Apply. A master switch turns it all off, and Edit Profile always shows your real info - Fake profile picture from Photos, the gallery, Files or a link, shown everywhere in the app on your device only - Hide explore reels: keeps only photo and carousel posts in explore, including the feed you open from it - Feed limits: cap how many posts load in a row and hide posts below a like, comment, view or repost count, on every home feed and the grid feed - Reels action button can save photo posts with their music, off by default - Keep Instants unseen after viewing them, and mark any one seen with the eye button in the viewer - Visited profiles: a private log of profiles you open, with notes, filters, multi-select and CSV or JSON export - Watchlist: add accounts from the profile menu, recent chats or search, checked on a schedule and for free when you open them, backing off for a day if Instagram limits you - Tracked changes: username, name, bio, link, picture, privacy, verification, follow back and count changes for watchlist accounts, with alerts per type and a home shortcut - Playback panel for reels and stories: live scrubber with elapsed and remaining time, bigger play/pause, custom skip step or frame by frame, hold skip to jump to the next or previous story or reel, and save the current frame - Playback speed can be remembered always, for the session, or just for the current video - Playback button in the reel sidebar: shows your speed, hold to flip between 1× and your last speed - Reel buttons can now move the action button and the playback button anywhere in the sidebar - Playback controls in the reels and stories action button, and an auto-advance switch in the story panel - Custom emoji fonts: import any color emoji font to replace emoji across Instagram - Force audio button: brings back the sound toggle in the DM camera ••• menu when your account is missing it - Group chats without a photo show their members' pictures in RyukGram lists - Links, emails and phone numbers in captions and comments are tappable; long-press one to copy or share it - Reels limit: choose Per session, the old doom scrolling cap, or Daily with time or reel caps per place or overall, a usage dashboard, day history, break nudges, a heads-up before the limit, strict mode and a shortcut. Once hit, reels stay paused everywhere and feed videos can hide
### 🛠 Fixes - DM inbox header buttons, chat menu, lock, refresh warning and Meta AI search button hiding work again on the new Instagram inbox - Posting and editing stories and taking photos no longer crash on iOS 15 backports - Downloading voice messages, forced DM save and Meta AI menu hiding work again on newer Instagram - Saved voice messages are named after the sender - Disabling feed autoplay, hiding story midcards and marking stories seen on sticker replies work again on newer Instagram - Profile and group pictures stay saved through expired links and cache clears, and Refresh names & photos updates every screen - Read notifications now work for people with their own settings even when the default for Read is off - Instagram's own reels auto-scroll mode works again, and turns off right away when you switch modes - Hide ads works again on accounts with the newer main feed and catches multi-ad carousels and sponsored posts in feed, profile feed and reels - Block surveys removes the "Are you interested in this ad" prompts under feed posts and reels - Profile updates in the analyzer show every change without cutting off the username, and entries no longer vanish while the list refreshes - Inbox header buttons and the profile action button no longer overlap the back button or username on older Instagram layouts - Reels opened from a profile no longer have a stuck comment bar covering the bottom, with a toggle to bring it back - Switching crop ratios no longer leaves the photo stuck zoomed in - Follow status in follower and following lists no longer shows the wrong answer, and loads without slowing down scrolling - Backup and restore now live on the Profiles page, so exporting, importing, resetting and storage are all in one place - The audio trimmer draws the real waveform of the clip, stays usable on long recordings with a draggable capped selection, and goes flat when the clip has no sound - A follow that becomes a request on a private account now shows as Requested instead of vanishing from the list - Batch follow and unfollow now run slower, pause on their own when Instagram pushes back, and stop before running past a safe daily amount - MobileConfig no longer wipes your overrides after repeated crashes, it turns them off and keeps them - MobileConfig overrides now actually apply, they were being written under an id Instagram never reads - Random crashes while chats or the inbox were loading, caused by keep deleted messages writing from two threads at once - Copying from the share sheet no longer closes Instagram - Rest…
